exposure: vaginal birth after caesarean delivery (VBAC)/trial of labor after caesarean delivery (TOLAC)
non-clinical human factors influencing quality and safety
outcome: quality and safety in obstetrical surgery
cohort: This is a review of existing literature focused on common obstetrical surgeries, not a study on a specific patient cohort.
finding: The review provides an overview of common obstetrical surgeries and identifies evidenced-based processes and considerations for improving quality and safety, including addressing non-clinical human factors and implementation barriers.
mod_finding: The review specifically addresses caesarean delivery, vaginal birth after caesarean delivery/trial of labor after caesarean delivery, and operative vaginal delivery as key obstetrical surgeries impacting quality and safety.
